# Café Memories

Café Memories is a Next.js / Supabase app for private customer photos, branch QR codes, merchant moderation and staff-verified visits. A display requires pairing and only receives approved photos with explicit customer consent.

Merchants can register and confirm an email account. Guests use a Supabase anonymous account on a venue page; their browser session is required to access their memories. Wallet passes, real billing, live printing and photobooth strips are not available in the current product.

Public pages: /, /privacy, /terms. Merchant registration: /login?mode=signup. Customer pages are tenant-specific and must not be treated as demo links.
